in_sanskrit.name: Pobitra
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Forest village
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Pobitra एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Pobitra comes from the Sanskrit words 'Pobha' meaning forest and 'Tara' meaning village. This name represents a peaceful and serene environment, often associated with the beauty and calmness of a forest village.
